text:
lee: quick sync: proposal to ship a small shim that accepts org-scoped API keys and issues short-lived project-scoped tokens. goal is to give customers time to split keys without emergency rekeying. reactions?

meera: pragmatic. top risks: audit lineage, revocation speed, and long-running workers relying on existing keys.

dan: agree. For audit, include `x-origin-key-suffix` and `x-delegation-id` on all downstream requests. logs redact full key but keep suffix.

tia: revocation approach idea: signed mapping files + pub/sub revocation. minted tokens include a `kv.ver` claim so we can reject tokens tied to older mapping versions.

lee: TTLs: suggest access token 300s, optional refresh token 1h for server migrations. prefer short by default.

meera: background jobs: provide CLI `rw-auth convert --org k_XXX --to svc:srv-YYY` that creates a service principal and migrates usage. give customers a 12-month migration window.

dan: mapping storage: customer-managed signed YAML in S3. shim validates signature (ed25519) and caches. allow force-reload endpoint.

tia: stateless vs stateful mapping: hybrid. rules are signed (stateless) for primary logic. maintain a small in-memory revocation cache for emergency invalidation; updates via pub/sub.

lee: API sketch: `POST /v1/shim/delegate` body { "org_key":"k_XXX","scope_hint":"project:foo:reader" } => { "access_token":"t_YYY","expires_in":300,"delegation_id":"d_123" }. response has `x-delegation-id` header.

meera: telemetry: `auth.shim.delegates{outcome,origin_type,customer_tier}` and `auth.shim.revocations{hit|miss}`. log `delegation_id` and masked origin key.

deploy-bot: deploy-check: canary in 2 regions, per-instance RPS cap 200, global burst cap 2000. circuit-breaker fallback -> legacy validation.

dan: fallback semantics: when shim falls back, annotate `x-auth-fallback:legacy` and emit event to `auth.fallbacks`. teams must accept that fallback may widen access compared to project tokens.

tia: security checklist: impersonation, replay, signing key compromise. mitigations: short TTLs, signed mappings, HSM for signing keys, TLS between components, and mandatory pen-test.

lee: cross-project keys: some org-keys used across many projects. mapping grammar should allow multi-project rules, e.g. `projects: [a,b]` with per-project roles. shim should mint per-project tokens, not a single wide token.

meera: mapping grammar draft: YAML signed envelope with fields: `customer_id`, `mappings: [{org_key_suffix, projects:[{id,roles}], allowed_ips?, admin_attestation}]` and `version`. sign payload and publish to S3 path `s3://mappings/<customer>/<version>.signed`.

dan: operational endpoints: `POST /v1/shim/reload` (admin), `GET /v1/shim/status` (revocation_cache_size,last_sync,mode). include `trace_id` in logs.

tia: audit chain: ensure we can reconstruct: org_key -> shim_mint (delegation_id) -> project_token -> downstream. propagate `audit_id` UUID in all logs.

lee: migration plan: 1) internal-only behind FF + simulation mode (no tokens issued) 2) telemetry mode (tokens issued but flagged in logs) 3) closed beta per-customer FF + mint quotas 4) gradual ramp + 12mo deprecation.

meera: SDK helpers: `rw-sdk.auth.delegate()` and `rw-cli rw-auth convert --dry-run`. docs + runbook for debugging delegation_id.

dan: billing tags: preserve `x-billing-tags` through delegation so chargeback remains accurate.

tia: add `auth.shim.errors` histogram and an alert for `mapping_mismatch_rate > 0.5%`. also require token introspection endpoint for ops, guarded by strong auth and audit.

deploy-bot: noted: will schedule canaries and create runbook steps for rollback (toggle FF, purge revocation cache).

sec: i'll lead threat model and pen-test sign-off. require HSM for signing keys and least-priv IAM for shim.

lee: thanks all. I'll draft RFC with API shape, mapping format, TTLs, revocation design, telemetry, and rollout steps. reviewers: @meera (mapping + SDK), @dan (ops & billing), @tia (security), @sec (pen-test).

meera: I'll draft the YAML envelope and admin UX for uploads.

dan: I'll handle ops endpoints and billing propagation tests.

tia: I'll collect threat scenarios and mitigations.

lee: sync Thu 9am to finalize TTLs and revocation window. add any last thoughts here. :thumbsup:
